notes: All values come from the last column 'Alin hyväksytyn pistemäärä, todistusvalinta YO' of TAMK's own 'Opiskelijavalinnan tilastoja' PDFs (page 1, AMK table); header order valintakoe / todistusvalinta AMM / todistusvalinta YO was checked in every document. Per the footnote, 'a/b' = first-timers/non-first-timers; a lone number is recorded as single. Rows where the YO cell is '-' or empty are kept with all values null (no YO cutoff published: e.g. music, Medianomi, valintakurssi programmes). Left out: Rakennusarkkitehti (AMK) päivätoteutus 2024 (YO '225/226') and 2025 (YO '200/255'), because the values exceed the 0–198 scale (the programme apparently uses a different points scale); in 2026 its YO cell is '-'. Kevät 2026 doc (syksy 2026 start) caveat: for most programmes the YO and AMM cells are '-' or blank and only the valintakoe column has a value (e.g. Fysioterapeutti '120/140', Sairaanhoitaja päivä '93/119', Rakennusarkkitehti '177/202'), and the hyväksytyt columns are missing from that year's table. It is unclear whether those valintakoe-column values include certificate-based selection, so they were NOT used; YO values were recorded only for the 8 programmes whose YO column is filled (Bioanalyytikko, Biotuotekniikka, Laboratoriotekniikka muuntokoulutus, Rakennusmestari infra, Restonomi verkko, Tekniikan monialainen, Ohjelmistotuotanto, Pelituotanto). Vipunen nevertheless lists e.g. Fysioterapeutti/Sairaanhoitaja 2026 as hakukohteet, so the 2026 nulls should be read as 'not published in this document', not necessarily 'no certificate selection'. Laboratoriotekniikka muuntokoulutus 2026 YO value is a single '28' (only 2 first-timer applications) – within scale and recorded as published, but unusually low. Autumn 2026 joint application (spring 2027 start) results are not yet published (haku Sept 2026). pdfplumber garbled a few names (overlapping text) in the 2026/syksy2025 PDFs; names were restored manually to the visible PDF text. Vipunen matches for kevät 2024 used reworded names (e.g. 'Konetekniikan tutkinto-ohjelma' -> 'Konetekniikka'; 'Rakennusalan työnjohdon tutkinto-ohjelma, päivätoteutus' -> the only Rakennusmestari päivä hakukohde, talonrakennus).
